lines.text: Did you know? Rupt is Latin for break.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus break?

words.ex: Sorry to interrupt, but your client is here.
The corrupt official was removed from his job.
The volcano last erupted nearly two hundred years ago.

publish.title: Rupt root: interrupt, corrupt and erupt
publish.value: Rupt comes from Latin "rumpere" (to break). Words: interrupt, corrupt and erupt. interrupt = inter + rupt; corrupt = cor + rupt; erupt = e + rupt.
